raw_segments.text: Very naturally, even Becky was beginning to look plumper and less frightened.
She had her share in the secret fairy story, too.
She had two mattresses, two pillows, plenty of bed covering, and every night a hot supper
and a seat on the cushions by the fire.
Two comforted children sat in the midst of delights.
Sometimes Sarah read aloud from her books.
Sometimes she learned her own lessons.
Sometimes she sat and looked into the fire and tried to imagine who her friend could be,
and wished she could say to him some of the things in her heart.
